```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
# Load the packages and shared helpers used to subset, cluster, and plot HBCs.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  cache = TRUE,
  autodep = TRUE,
  cache.comments = FALSE,
  cache.path = file.path(
    here::here("results", "cache", "publication_pipeline"),
    paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(knitr::current_input())), "/")
  )
)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratExtend)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
})
publication_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
source(file.path(publication_dir, "publication_helpers.R"), local = TRUE)
```

```{r get_data}
# Load the lineage object from notebook 03 when it is not already in memory.
# Reuse the lineage object from notebook 03 during a full-session run.
if (exists("filtered_seurat_lineageb")) {
  filtered_seurat <- filtered_seurat_lineageb
} else {
  filtered_seurat <- readRDS(file.path(params$download_dir, "olfactory_lineage.rds"))
}
```



```{r label-trp63-cells}
# Label cells by Trp63 expression to locate the HBC population.
trp63_expr <- FetchData(filtered_seurat, vars = "Trp63")
filtered_seurat$trp63_status <- ifelse(trp63_expr$Trp63 > 2, "Trp63+", "Trp63-")

DimPlot(filtered_seurat,
        reduction = "umap",
        group.by = "trp63_status",
        cols = c("Trp63-" = "grey80", "Trp63+" = "red"),
        pt.size = 0.5,
        order = "Trp63+") +
  theme_umap_arrows(x_label = "UMAP_1", y_label = "UMAP_2") +
  ggtitle("Trp63+ Cells") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

DimPlot(filtered_seurat, reduction = "umap", group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.6", label = TRUE)
```

```{r select-hbcs}
# Select cluster 9 for HBC-specific analysis.
hbc_subset <- subset(
  filtered_seurat,
  subset = (RNA_snn_res.0.6 == 9)
)
```

```{r assess_resolutions}
# Remove earlier clustering columns and reprocess the HBC subset.
res_cols <- grep("_snn_res\\.", colnames(hbc_subset@meta.data), value = TRUE)
hbc_subset@meta.data[res_cols] <- NULL

hbc_subset <- process_seurat_object(hbc_subset, resolution.range = c(0.3, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8))
```



```{r plot_clusters}
# Plot HBC clusters beside sample identity to inspect the selected resolution.
b <- DimPlot(hbc_subset, reduction = "umap", group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.3", label = TRUE)
c <- DimPlot(hbc_subset, reduction = "umap", group.by = "sample", shuffle = TRUE)
b | c
```

```{r cell_cycle_scores}
# Score cell-cycle phase so quiescent and cycling HBC states can be compared.
phase_analysis <- score_and_plot_cell_cycle(hbc_subset, cc_genes = cc.genes, reduction = "umap")
phase_plot <- phase_analysis[["phase_plot"]] + theme_umap_arrows(x_label = "UMAP_1", y_label = "UMAP_2")
phase_plot
```
```{r assign-hbc-groups, fig.width=6, fig.height=3}
# Map HBC cluster numbers to broad groups and define their colors.

total_cells_per_sample <- hbc_subset@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(total_cells = n(), .groups = "drop")

counts <- hbc_subset@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample, RNA_snn_res.0.3) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ungroup()

counts <- merge(counts, total_cells_per_sample, by = "sample")
counts <- counts %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_name = as.character(RNA_snn_res.0.3),
    broad_cluster = case_when(
      cluster_name %in% c("3", "4", "5") ~ "cycling",
      cluster_name %in% c("0", "1", "2") ~ "resting",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    percentage = (count / total_cells) * 100
  )

counts <- counts %>%
  mutate(
    group_label = paste(broad_cluster, cluster_name, sep = "_"),
    group_label = factor(group_label, levels = rev(sort(unique(group_label))))
  )

# Define the cycling and resting shade palette used by the HBC UMAP.
base_colors <- c(cycling = "#d62728", resting = "#377eb8")

group_colors <- c()
for (bc in unique(counts$broad_cluster)) {
  if (is.na(bc)) next
  subclusters <- counts %>% filter(broad_cluster == bc) %>% pull(cluster_name) %>% unique() %>% sort()
  shades <- generate_shades(base_colors[[bc]], length(subclusters))
  names(shades) <- paste(bc, subclusters, sep = "_")
  group_colors <- c(group_colors, shades)
}


# Match the figure: p1 at bottom and p22 at top
age_order <- c("p1", "p3", "p5", "p8", "p15", "p22")

# Match the figure legend:
# resting HBCs = blues (0–2), cycling HBCs = reds (3–5)
cluster_colors <- c(
  "0" = "#B3CDE3",
  "1" = "#6497D3",
  "2" = "#084081",
  "3" = "#FBB4AE",
  "4" = "#EF3B2C",
  "5" = "#7F0000"
)

hbc_counts <- hbc_subset@meta.data %>%
  mutate(
    age = tolower(as.character(sample)),
    cluster = as.character(RNA_snn_res.0.3)
  ) %>%
  count(age, cluster, name = "count") %>%
  group_by(age) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    age = factor(age, levels = age_order),
    cluster = factor(cluster, levels = as.character(0:5))
  )

clust_membership <- ggplot(
  hbc_counts,
  aes(x = percentage, y = age, fill = cluster)
) +
  geom_col(
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = cluster_colors,
    breaks = as.character(0:5),
    drop = FALSE,
    name = "Cluster"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
    labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Percentage (%)",
    y = "Age"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r plot-hbc-clusters, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
# Plot the labeled HBC clusters with the established group colors.
cluster_colors <- group_colors
names(cluster_colors) <- sub("^.+?_", "", names(cluster_colors))

umap_plot <- DimPlot(
  hbc_subset,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.3",
  cols = cluster_colors,
  pt.size = 0.5,
  label = TRUE,
  label.size = 4
) +
  theme_umap_arrows(x_label = "UMAP_1", y_label = "UMAP_2") +
  ggtitle("HBC Subclusters") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
```

```{r combine-hbc-plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
# Combine the HBC UMAP, cell-cycle, and membership panels for inline display.
all_hbc_plot <- (umap_plot | phase_plot) / clust_membership
all_hbc_plot
```


```{r save-hbc-object, cache=FALSE}
# Save the final HBC subset for reuse when output writing is enabled.
if (isTRUE(params$save_outputs)) {
  saveRDS(hbc_subset, file.path(params$output_dir, "hbc_subset.rds"))
}
```
